syntax.input_order: Definition order; variadic expressions preserve array order.

literal_types.description: RGBA Float32 color; channels are not clamped.

nodes.title: Add
nodes.description: Adds compatible numbers/vectors/colors, or concatenates strings using VM conversion rules.

nodes.title: And
nodes.description: Evaluates right only when left is true; operands must be Bool.

nodes.title: Create array
nodes.description: Evaluates items in order and creates a new array.

nodes.title: Array concatenate
nodes.description: Creates a new array containing both arrays in order.

nodes.title: Array contains
nodes.description: Tests one value or an array of values for membership, using VM equality and numeric promotion.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Single value, or array of values to match.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Match any or all values when value is an array.

nodes.title: Array get
nodes.description: Reads an array element by index.

nodes.title: Array length
nodes.description: Returns the number of array elements.

nodes.title: Array push
nodes.description: Appends a value and returns the same array.

nodes.title: Array remove
nodes.description: Removes an element and returns the same array.

nodes.title: Array set
nodes.description: Replaces an array element and returns the same array.

nodes.title: Call function
nodes.description: Calls an explicitly registered host function once. The host defines its positional argument contract.

inputs.name: args
inputs.description: Positional argument expressions in source order; omitted/null means empty.

nodes.title: Clamp
nodes.description: Returns min, value or max according to numeric comparisons.

nodes.title: Constant
nodes.description: Returns a literal; primitive JSON, arrays and tagged literals are shorthand forms.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Literal value; objects become dictionaries unless tagged with $type.

nodes.title: Divide
nodes.description: Divides left by right. Integer zero divisors fail; floating-point division follows IEEE 754.

nodes.title: Equal
nodes.description: Tests equality after VM type promotion.

nodes.title: Greater or equal
nodes.description: Tests whether left is greater than or equal to right.

nodes.title: Greater than
nodes.description: Tests whether left is greater than right.

nodes.title: If
nodes.description: Evaluates the condition and only the selected branch. Missing else returns Null.

nodes.title: In range
nodes.description: Tests inclusive bounds: min <= value <= max.

nodes.title: Less or equal
nodes.description: Tests whether left is less than or equal to right.

nodes.title: Less than
nodes.description: Tests whether left is less than right.

nodes.title: Maximum
nodes.description: Returns the original larger operand after numeric comparison.

nodes.title: Minimum
nodes.description: Returns the original smaller operand after numeric comparison.

nodes.title: Modulo
nodes.description: Computes integer remainder; promoted floating operands are truncated to Int32 by the existing conversion table.

nodes.title: Multiply
nodes.description: Multiplies numbers or corresponding vector/color components using VM numeric promotion.

nodes.title: Negate
nodes.description: Negates a number or each vector/color component.

nodes.title: Not
nodes.description: Negates a value after its supported conversion to Bool.

nodes.title: Not equal
nodes.description: Tests inequality after VM type promotion.

nodes.title: Call method
nodes.description: Calls one permitted host method on the target object.

inputs.name: target
inputs.description: Host object supplied by the game, normally through a variable.

inputs.name: args
inputs.description: Positional argument expressions; omitted/null means empty.

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: Non-empty method name; native Godot names use snake_case.

nodes.title: Get property
nodes.description: Reads a property through the injected host adapter.

inputs.name: target
inputs.description: Host object supplied by the game, normally through a variable.

nodes.title: Method names
nodes.description: Returns permitted method names reported by the host adapter.

inputs.name: target
inputs.description: Host object supplied by the game, normally through a variable.

nodes.title: Property names
nodes.description: Returns property names reported by the host adapter.

inputs.name: target
inputs.description: Host object supplied by the game, normally through a variable.

nodes.title: Has method
nodes.description: Checks whether a method is permitted by the host adapter.

inputs.name: target
inputs.description: Host object supplied by the game, normally through a variable.

nodes.title: Has property
nodes.description: Checks whether the host exposes a property.

inputs.name: target
inputs.description: Host object supplied by the game, normally through a variable.

nodes.title: Object valid
nodes.description: Tests host object validity; Null returns false.

nodes.title: Set property
nodes.description: Writes a property and returns the target object.

inputs.name: target
inputs.description: Host object supplied by the game, normally through a variable.

nodes.title: Or
nodes.description: Evaluates right only when left is false; operands must be Bool.

nodes.title: Read variable
nodes.description: Reads a variable from this invocation; missing variables fail.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Non-empty name of the invocation variable.

nodes.title: Sequence
nodes.description: Evaluates every step in order; returns the last result or Null for an empty list.

nodes.title: Subtract
nodes.description: Subtracts the right operand from the left using VM numeric promotion.

nodes.title: While
nodes.description: Repeats body while condition is true; returns the last body result or Null. Execution limits still apply.

inputs.name: condition
inputs.description: Bool expression re-evaluated before every iteration.
